test_cases.title: Reset password for a registered user
test_cases.objective: Verify that a registered user can successfully reset their password.

steps.action: Enter a valid, registered email address in the 'Forgot Password' field.
steps.expected_result: A time-limited reset link is sent to the provided email address.

steps.action: Click on the password reset link received in the email.
steps.expected_result: The user is redirected to a page where they can set a new password.

steps.action: Enter a new password that satisfies the defined password policy.
steps.expected_result: The new password is saved and the user is able to log in with the new credentials.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: Confirmation message for unregistered email address
test_cases.objective: Verify that the same confirmation message is displayed regardless of whether the email address is registered.

steps.action: Enter an unregistered email address in the 'Forgot Password' field.
steps.expected_result: A confirmation message is displayed indicating that a reset link has been sent.

steps.action: Enter a registered email address in the 'Forgot Password' field.
steps.expected_result: The same confirmation message as in step 1 is displayed.

source_requirements: The same confirmation is shown for registered and unregistered emails.

test_cases.title: Password policy validation
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system prevents users from setting passwords that do not meet the defined password policy.

steps.action: Click on the password reset link received in the email.
steps.expected_result: The user is redirected to a page where they can set a new password.

steps.action: Enter a new password that does not satisfy the defined password policy (e.g., too short, missing special characters).
steps.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password does not meet the required criteria.
The new password is not saved and the user remains on the password reset page with the error message still displayed.

source_requirements: The new password must satisfy the password policy.

test_cases.title: Expired reset link
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system handles expired password reset links correctly.

steps.action: Enter a valid, registered email address in the 'Forgot Password' field and request a password reset link.
steps.expected_result: A time-limited reset link is sent to the provided email address.

steps.action: Wait for the reset link to expire (wait longer than the configured expiration time).
Click on the expired password reset link.
steps.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the link has expired and a new request must be made.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.
